rubric: One answer with four plausible alternatives
Observed runtime or explicit document-backed contract
Distinct reasoning, professional formatting and appropriate prerequisites

records.finding: Current PHP precedence is explicit; the choices contrast concatenation, arithmetic and obsolete grouping. The output retains its label.
False initial conditions separate precondition and postcondition loops; the body counts make the difference observable without side effects elsewhere.
Fallthrough is intentional and stops at the displayed break; distractors represent early stopping, overshooting and skipping the selected case.
Replaced an earlier array-union draft overlapping pilot 001. This version tests ordered list keys, including the effect of ksort, rather than defaults.
The caller retains the original object after local parameter rebinding; mutation and rebinding must be traced separately. No reference parameter is declared.
The mixed-key fixture makes both numeric reindexing and string-key retention visible; output choices preserve realistic array encodings.
The two booleans independently test an empty needle and case sensitivity; no strpos integer/false confusion is reused.
Interface membership and concrete class identity are separate observations. The interface is defined, so no hidden autoloader behavior is required.
Output before recursion and during unwinding is balanced around an explicit base case; wrong orders correspond to plausible stack-tracing errors.
Replacement order is explicit and introduced text can match a later search term. The comparison concerns cascading replacement, not escaping policy.
end positions the internal pointer, while foreach has independent iteration state. The final current observation distinguishes the two cursors.
Parallel columns and their tie-break order are visible. Both arrays are reordered together; no unspecified equal-row ordering affects the answer.
FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE separates invalid text from valid false; the prompt distinguishes parsing from a boolean cast.
The constant is defined before the call but after declaration; default evaluation timing, rather than namespace lookup, determines the result.
Only tested match conditions and the selected result emit labels. Distractors model eager result evaluation or omission of earlier failed conditions.
One invokable object is reused by array_map and the later call, so its running state persists; no clone is implied by callback dispatch.
Explicit casting remains permitted under strict_types, while an uncast Stringable object fails a strict string argument. The partial output is part of the answer.
The instrumented ArrayAccess object reports false from offsetExists; the trace proves offsetGet is skipped by coalescing.
send starts an unstarted generator and supplies its first yield; the returned value channel is distinguished from the final generator return.
The exception is injected through yield from, caught by the inner generator, and cleanup waits for resumption after its recovery yield.
A lazy proxy forwards state to a distinct backing object; this is not a renamed shallow-clone example or the non-lazy property bypass in 0124.
The inherited method shares its static local while a distinct override owns another slot. The stated PHP versions avoid older-version ambiguity.
Serialization restores a self-referential graph with a new ordinary object while preserving enum singleton identity. All serialized input is local.
Raw reflection writes bypass a backed property hook; ordinary reads still invoke the getter. Negative storage makes the bypass observable.
A throwing dynamic static initializer is retried until successful; subsequent calls reuse the initialized local. Failure and reuse are both observed.
The fixtures include empty, negative-only and zero maxima. All four candidates are executed, including the expected max-empty failure.
The original mixed input reaches strict in_array unchanged; coercion, loose membership and key membership each fail a distinct supplied case.
All four options use comparable guarded expressions. Literal prefix slicing is distinguished from global removal, character trimming and a contains-only guard.
The PHP 8 implode signature is separator then array. The fixed required output distinguishes reversed arguments and alternative representations.
The global-binding requirement is explicit. Copying GLOBALS, a static local and local reinitialization do not mutate the displayed global counter.
Cookie path identity is supplied; other attributes cannot target a same-name cookie at a different path. This is protocol review, not a claimed browser execution.
The fixture destroys an isolated session before clearing current variables. The timing explains why session_unset is not the chosen post-destruction operation.
Skipped upload indices reveal the parallel-array mapping; count of accepted names and error codes are not original file indices.
Blank CSV rows, quoted empty fields and string zero are separate fixtures. Explicit escape handling avoids unrelated PHP 8.4 deprecation.
EOF and errors are explicitly excluded and an event-loop deadline already exists; preserving the buffer and waiting avoids busy looping and data loss.
Braces disambiguate replacement backreference 1 followed by digit 0. Concatenating PHP strings does not change the resulting replacement grammar.
Integer keys are business IDs, so reindexing is a functional defect. Key sorting and reverse-value sorting remain plausible but wrong alternatives.
Resolving a two-trait conflict and exposing the excluded method under an alias are separate required operations; this differs from class/trait/parent precedence.
Imported names resolve lexically through ::class, not within arbitrary strings. Both namespaces are displayed and error catches are fully qualified.
Both a known and an unknown backing value are tested; from throwing cannot be repaired by null coalescing, while tryFrom supplies the nullable boundary.
Generation occurs after the build-time scan in a fresh worker. Optimized fallback and authoritative classmaps therefore have different guarantees.
The required JSON uses the backing value, and returning the same JsonSerializable enum would recurse. Each alternative is executed.
Replaced a weak clear-error distractor with an inverted transaction-state guard. The failure leaves SQLite's transaction active; cleanup must end it and remove pending rows.
Cloning preserves the stored closure's original binding unless explicitly rebound. The candidate must remain a Closure, excluding call's immediate result.
Fresh object identity and constructor-before-hydration are both required. FETCH_INTO and ordinary FETCH_CLASS satisfy only parts of the contract.
A loop break preserves accumulated state and permits the footer; returning and continuing have different scopes and observable output.
A shown handler handles warnings without converting them. Missing require additionally raises Error while include can proceed, so the catch is not equivalent.
The route's deliberate archival effect is idempotent but unsafe under HTTP semantics. Authentication and query placement do not change that distinction.
Append and lock are independent flags. The local fixture checks append behavior; the lock request is verified from the selected flag expression, not claimed concurrency proof.
The warning handler records an undefined-key diagnostic while destructuring supplies null. The answer accounts for both state and diagnostics.
An explicitly unset typed property enables this lazy __get path; removing unset is executed as a contrast and raises the expected access Error.
A successful throwing-mode decode leaves the prior legacy JSON error state unchanged. The earlier invalid decode is intentional and its provenance is visible.
Reinstalling a handler pushes another restoration level. The final caller restoration distinguishes stack balance from merely activating the right handler once.
The named timezone transition and offsets are explicit; calendar-day and elapsed-hour arithmetic produce different local clocks without relying on the current date.
The dummy password fixture verifies a real authentication bypass when rehash precedes verification. A corrected-order contrast rejects the wrong password.
Uniqueness and cryptographic unpredictability are distinct requirements; replacing the digest algorithm alone cannot supply missing random entropy.
The CLI witness tests PHP control flow only, not actual browser redirection. A helper return resumes the caller despite its Location header.
A public typed property bypasses __set for ordinary assignment; a private-property contrast invokes the range guard. Integer typing alone admits negatives.
The SAPI snapshot behavior is documented rather than simulated by CLI superglobal assignment. The premise explicitly distinguishes original input from modified userland data.
HTTP_HOST is request-derived despite being in SERVER. The required reset origin must come from trusted configuration, not syntax validation alone.
The controlled GCM vector proves a shortened matching tag can be accepted. The protocol's fixed 16-byte requirement is supplied and must be enforced by the caller.
A regex first-match gate and PHP's decoded last duplicate disagree. Throw-on-error is not a duplicate-member rejection policy.
Both Fibers share one PDO connection and its transaction. The exact schedule proves B's write is rolled back with A's, without external concurrency.
Only strings are decoded; no path is opened. JSON slash formatting is explicit, and the second decode creates the traversal representation after validation.
A by-reference generator declaration is required by this consumer. Removing the declaration ampersand is executed and verified as an exception, not silent copying.
A named later optional argument preserves earlier defaults. Wrong positional calls either bind a different parameter or change an explicitly required default.
The return type is mixed so incorrect candidates expose their actual API results. Empty and moved-pointer fixtures distinguish first-key lookup from pointer/value operations.
Both source preservation and numeric-key preservation are observed; slice direction, splice mutation and default reindexing each violate a stated requirement.
The absent-bit fixture separates idempotent clearing from XOR toggling. OR and AND with the uncomplemented mask have different effects.
Range predicates return booleans, so match(true) is deliberate. Age zero separates true from casting the input to boolean.
The ellipsis is explicitly literal syntax. Returning a Closure is required, so a callable string or an invoked function result does not qualify.
The child deliberately selects its parent's body; self, static and instance dispatch all select the shown override in this fixture.
Parameter binding does not quote LIKE wildcard syntax. The three prefix fixtures exercise percent, underscore and the chosen escape character without SQL concatenation of input.
A quoted newline spans physical lines within one CSV record. Both records are read, and all candidates are run against the same memory stream.
Cross-site subresource delivery, HTTPS, HttpOnly and permission for third-party cookies are explicit. The answer is a documented policy configuration, not a universal browser guarantee.
The needle includes both a regex metacharacter and the chosen delimiter. All candidates are checked against exact and lookalike strings and diagnostics.
WeakReference observes owner retention after unset; the correct static arrow captures only the scalar prefix. Other callable forms retain the owner or illegally use this.
The append-only trusted proxy contract and full chain are supplied. A corrected right-to-left contrast ignores the spoofed prefix and returns the intended boundary address.
SQLite DO NOTHING may succeed without insertion. rowCount distinguishes the claim, and the effect shares its transaction; replay payload and successful commits are explicit assumptions.
Separate strict callee and weak caller files expose coercion before body entry. mixed preserves original types so the explicit guard can enforce the required exception contract.
The terminal newline distinguishes $ from absolute end; ordinary wrong length and lowercase inputs are already rejected. Every test is run against original and repaired patterns.
The five-byte record exceeds fgets length minus one. This tests truncation, distinct from pilot 007's truthiness loss of a zero-valued line.
A direct base-class object separates is_a from is_subclass_of; descendants and an unrelated object provide passing controls.
The unusual exact-wire fractional-marker requirement is stated, without asserting that JSON has separate integer and float types. Integral floats expose the missing flag.
UTC midnight dates eliminate timezone ambiguity. Backward direction requires invert, while leap-day magnitude is already handled correctly by diff.
No magic dispatcher exists; an external scope cannot call the private method even though method_exists finds it. Public, inherited and absent methods are controls.
The parsed map forbids duplicate spellings and limits names to ASCII. Lowercasing keys leaves the mixed-case field value unchanged.
The pass-through identity requirement is explicit. New exceptions preserve this fixture's message, class and default code but fail strict object identity.
The decisive sequence reads, mutates and reads again. Added explicit enabled-assertion assumptions; isolated validation compares values directly and checks the cache repair.
Integer-only list inputs avoid array_diff's string-comparison issue. A repeated target distinguishes one-occurrence removal from exclusion of every match.
Partial-output flag precedence defeats the throwing policy for INF. Supported values remain controls; the repair removes only the substitution policy.
The tool's supported type forms are explicit. A union lacks getName while nullable string remains a named type; the repair iterates union members.
Private storage is defined as unreachable by every serving path. Random names, extensions and signature checks cannot satisfy mandatory scanner-before-publication ordering.
No transitive dependency can accidentally satisfy the runtime requirement. require-dev, suggest and autoload each address a different Composer concern.
Unbuffered input and a nonretaining synchronous sink are explicit. The remaining memory distinction is whether intermediate stages collect all data.
Only three known nonsensitive metadata fields are required. A constructed allowlist excludes future secrets by default; logging on errors and hashing all values do not.
Append-only immutable IDs make the cursor guarantee precise. Strict descending continuation excludes both the previous cursor row and later higher inserts.
The issuer permits only RS256 with a pinned RSA key. Header-controlled algorithm choice and key-ID matching cannot expand that trusted policy.
The process has already loaded the class and no patching extension exists. Draining workers separates in-flight release code from newly started processes.
File-lock identity and atomic-rename semantics are explicit premises. A permanent coordination file keeps all writers on the same lock across data replacements.
